name: Plan vs actual
description: Two columns side by side: what was planned and what happened.

content.title: Plan vs actual
content.leftBody:
- 44M€ revenue target
- 29% gross margin
- Two new regions (DACH, Nordics)
- Flat headcount
content.rightBody:
- **48.6M€** revenue (+11% over target)
- **31%** gross margin
- Three regions live (DACH, Nordics, Benelux)
- +14 net hires in sales
